authority: South Dakota Dept. of Labor & Regulation — SD Electrical Commission and SD Plumbing Commission (trades only)
notes: DLR's full list of occupational licensing boards has no general, building or residential contractor board. The only construction trades licensed at state level are electrical (SD Electrical Commission, https://dlr.sd.gov/electrical/default.aspx, fetched) and plumbing (SD Plumbing Commission, https://dlr.sd.gov/plumbing/default.aspx). No HVAC board is listed. The electrical commission page has no public licensee lookup or list; contact is electrical@state.sd.us. We did not find how the trade rosters can be accessed. Contractors do need a DOR contractor's excise tax licence, but that is a tax licence, not a competency licence.

authority: South Dakota Real Estate Commission (Dept. of Labor & Regulation)
notes: The licensee roster is a search form: name, firm, licence type and city, with no export. There are separate firm, timeshare and condo list pages under sdrec.sd.gov/registration/. The roster does not show addresses for inactive licensees. The only route to a bulk list is to ask the commission (dlr.realestate@state.sd.us, 605-773-3600); we did not establish whether it will supply one.

authority: Tennessee Board for Licensing Contractors (Dept. of Commerce & Insurance)
notes: This is a public Tableau dashboard ('Tennessee Contractor & Qualifying Agent Data', embedded at https://www.tn.gov/commerce/regboards/contractors/consumer/verify-qa.html). The page says the data can be sorted, searched and downloaded, with a CSV alternative. It is not a static file, and the full column set could not be read without rendering Tableau. The only field the page names is the qualifying agent; the others are not established. The view URL returned 200. The board licenses General Contractors, Home Improvement Contractors, Limited Licensed Electricians and Limited Licensed Plumbers. Per-licence lookup: https://search.cloud.commerce.tn.gov/.

authority: Tennessee Real Estate Commission (Dept. of Commerce & Insurance)
cadence: daily (per tn.gov: verify search results update daily)
notes: TREC's verify page redirects (302) to verify.tn.gov, which is a per-licence search. We found no roster, download or dashboard for real estate licensees on tn.gov. This differs from the contractor board, which does publish a dashboard.

authority: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR); plumbing is licensed separately by the Texas State Board of Plumbing Examiners (TSBPE)
file_format: Socrata open-data dataset (CSV/JSON/API) — dataset id 7358-krk7 'TDLR - All Licenses'
cadence: not_established (rowsUpdatedAt 2026-09-19; embedded row 'Generated By: Public Information Act (PIA) 9/18/2026')
notes: Texas has no state general or residential contractor licence. The state licenses trades only: TDLR licenses electrical contractors (about 14,019), A/C contractors (about 20,436), elevator and appliance-installation contractors and others. The dataset mixes every TDLR program, including barbers and cosmetology, so filter on license_type. It has no status column (license_subtype and continuing_education_flag only), and owner_name is present. Data defect: the license_type column contains footer junk rows, such as a Salesforce copyright notice and the 'Generated By: PIA' line, so those rows must be filtered out. Plumbing is licensed by TSBPE, which publishes free CSV licensee lists (Responsible Master Plumber, Master Plumber, inspectors) at https://tsbpe.texas.gov/free-licensee-list/, current as of the previous workday; that page was seen in search results only, not fetched.

authority: Texas Real Estate Commission (TREC)
file_format: Socrata open-data dataset (CSV/JSON/API) — dataset id s7ft-44qi 'Broker and Sales Agent License Holder Information'
notes: Listed on TREC's High Value Data Sets page (https://www.trec.texas.gov/public/high-value-data-sets, fetched). It covers current licensees plus those expired, suspended, revoked or deceased within the last 5 years. There are no address columns. It carries related_license_* fields (the sponsoring broker) and agency_identifier. Companion datasets: Inspectors pkr9-9isv, Easement/ROW agents 3p42-m5cn, Applications bf5n-799f.

authority: Utah Division of Professional Licensing (DOPL), Dept. of Commerce
terms: fee ($5 minimum including the first 200 records, then $0.03 per record; full list $0.01 per record). Address, phone and email only with DOPL approval (Utah Code 58-1-106(2))
notes: The DOPL list covers contractors along with every other DOPL profession. Name, licence type and status are included by default; the example list also shows licence number, issue and expiry dates, and discipline. List questions go to dopllist@utah.gov, 801-530-6628. Free per-licence lookup: https://secure.utah.gov/llv/search/index.html. DOPL also runs a free Construction Business Registry search at https://db.dopl.utah.gov/cbr/ (a lookup, returned 200).

authority: Utah Division of Real Estate (Dept. of Commerce)
terms: fee ($5 minimum including the first 200 records, then $0.03 per record)
notes: The list covers real estate agents, brokers and companies, plus appraisers and mortgage licensees. It includes full name, issue date, address with county, and phone. The page says real estate lists do not include email, and that company affiliation is not available for mortgage licences moved to NMLS. Free per-licence lookup: https://secure.utah.gov/rer/relv/search.html (returned 200).

authority: Vermont Secretary of State, Office of Professional Regulation (OPR) — Residential Contractor registration
file_format: not_established (a 'Profession Roster Download' inside the OPR lookup app)
notes: Vermont does not license general contractors. Residential contractors must register with OPR as of 2023-04-01; this is a registration, not a competency licence (https://sos.vermont.gov/residential-contractors, fetched). OPR's Find a Professional page (fetched) says to use the 'Profession Roster Download' option in the lookup app for an exportable list. The app is JavaScript-only (it returned a 307), so the download was not exercised. The field list comes from OPR's own description of the search results (name, city/state/zip, licence number and type, dates, status); the roster's actual columns are not confirmed. Per the OPR page, electricians and plumbers appear to fall under the Division of Fire Safety; this was not independently confirmed.

authority: Vermont Real Estate Commission (Office of Professional Regulation, Secretary of State)
file_format: not_established (Profession Roster Download in the OPR lookup app)
notes: Same OPR platform and roster-download mechanism as residential contractors. The mechanism is stated on https://sos.vermont.gov/opr/find-a-professional (fetched), but the download was not exercised because the app is JavaScript-only. Fields are from OPR's description of the lookup and are not confirmed from a file.

authority: Virginia Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation (DPOR) — Board for Contractors
approx_rows: approx 22k Class A + 5.5k Class B + 7.5k Class C (estimated from file sizes, not counted)
notes: All files are listed at https://www.dpor.virginia.gov/RegulantLists. The contractor files are 2705a/2705b/2705c__crnt.txt for Class A/B/C, 2701 and 2703 for temporary contractors, plus the tradesman files 2709/2710 (electrical, plumbing, HVAC and gas fitter tradesmen are DPOR licences). Columns: BOARD, OCCUPATION, CERTIFICATE #, INDIVIDUAL NAME, BUSINESS NAME, address, EXPIRATION DATE, CERTIFICATION DATE, LICENSE RANK, LICENSE SPECIALTY (for example HIC, RBC, CBC, HVA), EMAILADDRESS. There is no status column; the files are current licensees. There is no county column and no qualifier name. Tradesman designations PDF: .../Regulant%20List/tradesman%20designations.pdf.

authority: Virginia DPOR — Real Estate Board
approx_rows: approx 40k active salespersons in 0225s_act (estimated from file size, not counted), plus separate broker and firm files
notes: The data is split across files. Individuals: 0225a/0225o/0225p/0225s, each as _act.txt and _inact.txt (associate broker, sole proprietor, principal broker, salesperson); status is implied by which file a record is in. Firms: 0226f, 0226l, 0226o, 0226b (branch). The columns match the contractor files and include email. There is no county and no sponsoring-firm link: DPOR says business affiliation lists must be requested from publicrecords@dpor.virginia.gov, 804-367-8583 option 5.

authority: Washington State Department of Labor & Industries (L&I) — contractor registration (RCW 18.27)
file_format: Socrata open-data dataset (CSV/JSON/API) — dataset id m8qx-ubtq 'L&I Contractor License Data - General'
notes: This is a statewide registration covering general and specialty contractors. Columns: businessname, contractorlicensenumber, type code and description, address, phone, effective and expiry dates, business type, specialtycode1/2 with descriptions, UBI, primaryprincipalname, status. There is no county and no qualifier. Companion datasets: Principals 4xk5-x9j6, Bond bzff-4fmt, Insurance ciwg-agsx, Authorized Signer s7ge-wicw. Electricians and plumbers are certified separately by L&I; we did not survey those.

authority: Washington State Department of Licensing (DOL) — Real Estate program
terms: redistribution restricted: commercial use of lists of individuals is prohibited under RCW 42.56
notes: data.wa.gov has only DOL aggregate datasets (licence counts, transaction counts such as ixni-jq78 and hasg-mr3s), not a roster. A bulk list is possible only by public records request to dolpublicrecords@dol.wa.gov, 360-902-7100 (https://dol.wa.gov/about/public-disclosure/types-public-records, fetched). The lookup URL comes from DOL search results and was not fetched directly.

authority: West Virginia Contractor Licensing Board (WV Division of Labor)
notes: The search can filter by classification, name, DBA, city or county. Result columns are licence number, company, DBA, address, county, phone, classification and expiry. There is no export. The Division of Labor's other trade searches (HVAC technicians, plumbers, at https://labor.wv.gov/database-search) are also search-only. A bulk list is presumably available by request to clboard@wv.gov, 304-558-7890; not established.

authority: West Virginia Real Estate Commission
approx_rows: not_established (files are 384 KB salespersons, 61 KB associate brokers, 121 KB brokers)
notes: The Active Licensee Rosters page is https://rec.wv.gov/About/Pages/Active-Licensee-Rosters.aspx. The three files are Salespersons Active.xlsx, AB Active.xlsx and Broker Active.xlsx under /About/Documents/Active%20Rosters/. Header checks returned 200 with Last-Modified 2026-07-01. The files were not downloaded, so columns are not established. The rosters cover active licensees only.

authority: Wisconsin Department of Safety and Professional Services (DSPS) — Dwelling Contractor certification plus trade credentials
terms: fee (per search results, a list of all DSPS credential types is $2,000; prices for single professions not established)
notes: There is no commercial or general contractor licence. Anyone pulling a building permit for a one- or two-family dwelling must hold a DSPS Dwelling Contractor (or Dwelling Contractor Restricted) certification and employ a certified Dwelling Contractor Qualifier (https://dsps.wi.gov/Pages/Professions/DwellingContractor/Default.aspx, fetched). DSPS also credentials electrical, plumbing and HVAC trades. The list purchasing system at app.wi.gov/DSPSLicenseList returns a 301 to dspslicenselist.wi.gov, and that domain does not resolve (NXDOMAIN via 8.8.8.8 on 2026-09-28), so the purchase route could not be confirmed as working. Per-licence lookup: https://license.wi.gov/s/license-lookup.

authority: Wisconsin DSPS — Real Estate Examining Board
terms: fee (not established per profession; all credential types $2,000 per search results); addresses exclude holders who opted out
notes: Same DSPS purchasing system as contractors, and its target domain dspslicenselist.wi.gov did not resolve on 2026-09-28. Per-licence lookup: https://license.wi.gov/s/license-lookup (per the DSPS Public Look-Up page, fetched). We found no free bulk file or open-data dataset.

authority: Wyoming Department of Fire Prevention & Electrical Safety (State Fire Marshal) — electrical only
notes: Wyoming has no state general or building contractor licence; that is local jurisdiction. The only state construction licensing is electrical: Electrical Contractor, Low Voltage/Limited Contractor, Master, Journeyman, Low-Voltage Technician and Apprentice. The licensing page offers no public lookup or list, only the applicant portal https://wyelectrician.imagetrendlicense.com/lms/public/ (not fetched). Plumbing is not licensed at state level per search results; not independently confirmed.

authority: Wyoming Real Estate Commission
notes: realestate.wyo.gov links 'Verify a License' to online.wyrec.org (returned 200; it is a JavaScript app). The site has no roster or download. The two Google Sheets linked from the site are continuing-education course lists, not rosters. The older GL Suite search URL (wyrec.glsuite.us) did not respond. For a list, contact realestatecommission@wyo.gov, 307-777-7141.

authority: Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation (DBPR) — Construction Industry Licensing Board (CILB)
file_format: csv (no header row, all fields quoted)
notes: Listed on https://www2.myfloridalicense.com/construction-industry/public-records/ as active, inactive and voluntarily inactive construction licensees. Sampled columns: board code, class (CBC, etc.), name, DBA, address, county code, licence number, status codes, original, effective and expiry dates, and full licence number (e.g. CBC006261). The trailing columns were not identified; whether a qualifier or business link is present is not established. Other files: constr_app.csv (applicants), cilb_certified.csv and cilb_registered.csv (continuing education), and annual discipline CSVs under /pro/cilb/reports/.

authority: Florida DBPR — Florida Real Estate Commission (FREC)
file_format: csv (no header row, all fields quoted)
notes: Listed on https://www2.myfloridalicense.com/real-estate-commission/public-records/. The file covers individual sales associates and brokers. Sampled columns: board/type, name, rank (BK Broker, BL Broker Sales, etc.), address, county name, licence number, primary and secondary status, dates, expiry, full licence number, employing brokerage name and brokerage licence number. Companion files: RealEstateCorpLicense.csv (corporations, partnerships, branches), RealEstateSchoolLicense.csv, and regional splits RE_rgn1.csv to RE_rgn14.csv (RE_rgn5 checked: 200, Last-Modified 2026-09-28).
